title: Predicting Progression of Ophthalmic Disease Using Deep Temporal Sequence Network
author: Jiewei Jiang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qgzdtx6

steps.title: Install Prerequisite Libraries
steps.instruction: Install the required software libraries to ensure the environment is ready for the experiment.

steps.title: Prepare Dataset and Code
steps.instruction: Clone the TempSeq-Net repository and compile the necessary frameworks on a Linux OS (e.g., Ubuntu 14.04 64bits).

substeps.instruction: Clone the repository from https://github.com/Ophthalmology-CAD/TempSeq-Net.git to a folder referred to as $ROOT
Navigate to $ROOT and compile Caffe and pycaffe by running: make all, make test, make runtest, and make pycaffe

steps.title: Download Pre-trained Models
steps.instruction: Download the required pre-trained models and place them in their respective directories.

substeps.instruction: Download the alexnet model from https://people.eecs.berkeley.edu/~lisa_anne/single_frame_all_layers_hyb_RGB_iter_5000.caffemodel and place it in $ROOT/examples/LSTM-AlexNet
Download the googlenet model from https://github.com/BVLC/caffe/tree/master/models/bvlc_googlenet and place it in $ROOT/examples/LSTM-GoogLeNet
Download the ResNet-50 model from https://github.com/KaimingHe/deep-residual-networks#models and place it in $ROOT/examples/LSTM-ResNet

steps.title: Train Prediction Models
steps.instruction: Train the six potential prediction models for ophthalmic disease using the provided shell scripts.

substeps.instruction: Train the lstm-alexnet model: cd $ROOT/examples/LSTM-AlexNet and run sh run_lstm_alexnet_RGB.sh
Train the lstm-googlenet model: cd $ROOT/examples/LSTM-GoogLeNet and run sh run_lstm_googlenet_RGB.sh
Train the lstm-resNet model: cd $ROOT/examples/LSTM-ResNet and run sh run_lstm_resnet_RGB.sh

steps.title: Evaluate Model Performance
steps.instruction: Evaluate the performance of the six potential prediction models using the test code.
